issues.fix: Optional: scale pyW down on aft-facing faces at the PY end (e.g. pyW *= mix(1.0, 0.5, step(0.5, N.z) * smoothstep(u_pyCool.y - 1.5, u_pyCool.y - 0.5, v_wpos.z))) so the rear wall lands near +10, and leave the side faces at 0.9.
